name: kie-creator-for-claude
description: Create images, videos, edits, and voiceovers in Claude using flexible pay-as-you-go KIE credits.
long_description: A lower-cost, Higgsfield-style creative workflow inside Claude. Describe what you want, attach reference media when needed, and let Claude create with KIE's image, video, and speech models.

kie_api_key.title: Your KIE API key
kie_api_key.description: Create or copy your key at https://kie.ai/api-key. Claude stores it securely on this device.

media_directory.title: Reference media folder
media_directory.description: Choose one folder containing only the images, videos, and audio you want your AI agent to be able to send to KIE.

tools.name: kie_create_image
tools.description: Create or edit an image from a prompt and optional references.

tools.name: kie_create_video
tools.description: Create a video from text, images, video, or audio references.

tools.name: kie_get_creation
tools.description: Wait for or check a submitted creation.

tools.name: kie_upload_media
tools.description: Upload reference media directly through KIE's native upload service.
